articles.title_en: Comparative advantage and the quality choice of heterogeneous firms
articles.title_cn: 比较优势与异质性企业的质量选择
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the role played by comparative advantage in shaping the impact that trade has on a firm’s product quality across industries. We develop a Heckscher-Ohlin model with firm heterogeneity and endogenous quality upgrading. Trade openness increases an exporter’s product quality differently across industries, with a larger effect in a country’s comparative advantage industry. Differences in factor endowments across countries translate into differences in factor prices which affect the firm’s marginal costs of production. The cost-advantage that firms enjoy in a country’s comparative advantage industry increases the firm’s prospective market size abroad, increasing the incentives to invest in product quality. Introducing endogenous firm-level comparative advantage based on differences in factor intensity within an industry, reveals that the firm’s response to trade openness in terms of quality choice is shaped by the firm and industry determinants of comparative advantage: Firms that use more intensively the factor in which the country is more abundant will increase quality to a larger extent. Using transaction-level data from Chinese firms, we find empirical support for the model predictions; Chinese exporters produce higher-quality products in those industries in which China reveals a comparative advantage.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了比较优势在塑造贸易对企业在各行业产品质量影响方面所发挥的作用。我们构建了一个包含企业异质性和内生质量升级的Heckscher-Ohlin模型。贸易开放会以不同方式提高出口商在各行业的产品质量，在一国的比较优势行业中效应更大。国家间要素禀赋的差异转化为要素价格的差异，进而影响企业的边际生产成本。企业在一国比较优势行业中所享有的成本优势，增加了企业在国外的潜在市场规模，从而提高了投资于产品质量的激励。引入基于行业内要素密集度差异的内生企业层面比较优势后，可以发现企业对贸易开放在质量选择方面的反应，受到比较优势的企业决定因素和行业决定因素的塑造：更密集使用该国更丰裕要素的企业，将更大程度地提高质量。使用中国企业的交易层面数据，我们发现了对模型预测的经验支持；中国出口商在中国显示出比较优势的那些行业中生产更高质量的产品。

articles.title_en: How did empirical economic research improve over the last decades: Recent trends and prospects
articles.title_cn: 过去几十年实证经济研究如何改进：近期趋势与展望
articles.abstract_en: We map the evolution of economics research from 1998 to 2019 to assess progress and identify remaining challenges. Using text mining of 30,675 full-text articles and an in-depth analysis of 578,132 statistical tests from 3746 articles across a broad range of journals, we document changes in research practices over time. We highlight the influence of the credibility revolution and the open science movement. Awareness of reproducibility has increased modestly, largely driven by journal adoption of data and code sharing policies. At the same time, reliance on non-public data has grown, especially among authors at top-five universities, posing new challenges for transparency. Sample sizes have increased substantially, while reported effect sizes have declined, consistent with reduced exaggeration and potentially more policy-relevant estimates. Econometric methods and causal inference practices have become more sophisticated, and articles now report more tables and statistical tests. However, pre-analysis plans, power analyses accompanying null results, and corrections for multiple hypothesis testing remain uncommon. Article length has remained stable or declined slightly, and authors from top-five universities continue to represent a large and stable share of publications in top journals. Our findings provide a baseline for tracking future developments and for guiding efforts to further strengthen the credibility and transparency of economics research.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们梳理了从1998到2019经济学研究的演变，以评估进展并识别剩余挑战。通过对30,675篇全文文章进行文本挖掘，并对来自广泛期刊的3746篇文章中的578,132项统计检验进行深入分析，我们记录了研究实践随时间的变化。我们强调了可信性革命和开放科学运动的影响。对可复现性的意识略有提高，这主要由期刊采用数据和代码共享政策所推动。与此同时，对非公开数据的依赖有所增加，尤其是在排名前五大学的作者中，这给透明度带来了新的挑战。样本量大幅增加，而报告的效应量有所下降，这与夸大程度降低以及可能更具政策相关性的估计相一致。计量经济学方法和因果推断实践变得更加复杂，文章现在报告更多的表格和统计检验。然而，预分析计划、伴随零结果的功效分析以及多重假设检验校正仍然不常见。文章长度保持稳定或略有下降，来自排名前五大学的作者在顶级期刊出版物中继续占据大而稳定的份额。我们的发现为追踪未来发展以及为指导进一步加强经济学研究可信性和透明度的努力提供了基准。

articles.title_en: Captured gatekeepers: Structural conflicts of interest in U.S. higher education accreditation
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the structural ties between federally recognized programmatic accreditors and their affiliated professional and trade associations, arguing that these organizational arrangements constitute conflicts of interest that compromise the quality-assurance function accreditation is intended to serve. Drawing on a novel dataset constructed from IRS Form 990 XML filings for 25 accreditor-association pairs over a seven-year panel (2017–2023), we develop and operationalize a three-part typology of capture mechanisms: structural subordination, financial entanglement, and governance overlap. We construct a Regulatory Capture Index (RCI) to measure the intensity of structural capture across the sample. Twenty-two of the 25 pairs are joined by a shared employer identification number, a consolidated filing, or a single legal identity, leaving three structurally separate accreditors; all fourteen licensure-gated health professions pairs score at the maximum RCI of 1.0. Scores are bimodal and static, with no pair occupying an intermediate position and none altering its organizational form across the panel. Because shared legal identity leaves no arm’s-length financial or governance record, separation is observationally indistinguishable from complete entanglement for 88 percent of the sample, suggesting that the arrangements that most compromise independence are precisely those that generate the least evidence of it.

articles.title_en: Culture and constitutional compliance
articles.title_cn: 文化与宪法遵从
articles.abstract_en: Constitutions as the formal foundation of a country’s legal and political system have important economic and political effects. Yet, we still know little about why constitutions set effective constraints on politicians in some societies, while being largely disregarded in others. Here, we ask if national culture matters for constitutional compliance. We study a cross-section of 115 countries, making use of novel indicators of constitutional compliance. We find that societies with a more individualistic population exhibit higher levels of compliance. These results are robust and extend to instrumental variables estimations. They imply a novel transmission channel from cultural traits to long-term economic development: individualistic national culture increases the credibility of constitutional self-commitments. Our analysis also supports the more general idea that the effects of formal institutions depend on the informal institutional environment in which they are embedded. Regarding religion, our results are consistent with past research that attributes the lack of development in the modern Muslim world to deficient institutional quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 宪法作为一国法律和政治制度的正式基础，具有重要的经济和政治效应。然而，我们仍然很少了解为什么宪法在一些社会中对政治家设定了有效约束，而在另一些社会中却基本上被忽视。在此，我们探讨民族文化是否对宪法遵从重要。我们研究了一个包含115个国家的横截面，利用了新的宪法遵从指标。我们发现，人口更具个人主义的社会表现出更高的遵从水平。这些结果是稳健的，并扩展到工具变量估计。它们暗示了一条从文化特征到长期经济发展的新颖传导渠道：个人主义的民族文化提高了宪法自我承诺的可信度。我们的分析还支持一个更普遍的观点，即正式制度的效果取决于其所嵌入的非正式制度环境。关于宗教，我们的结果与过去的研究一致，后者将现代穆斯林世界的发展不足归因于制度质量缺陷。

articles.title_en: Publicly funded R&D networks, knowledge spillovers and innovation performance: Evidence from Norway
articles.title_cn: 公共资助的研发网络、知识溢出与创新绩效：来自挪威的证据
articles.abstract_en: Many countries provide public policy support for R&D networks. In publicly funded R&D consortia, firms collaborate with each other and with public scientific institutions to carry out joint innovation projects. The idea behind these policy schemes is that collaborative innovation enables firms to benefit from knowledge spillovers within R&D networks. Surprisingly, however, there is no empirical research showing that spillover effects actually exist in publicly funded R&D consortia. This paper seeks to investigate the extent and sources of knowledge spillovers in R&D networks and to distinguish them from other drivers of additionality generated by collaborative innovation policy programs. Our empirical analysis focuses on Norway and encompasses the entire population of firms supported by R&D policy programs over the period 2002–2022, comprising approximately 15500 collaborative projects. Based on the information on each project, we construct networks of innovators and new R&D spillover pool variables. We use a spatial autoregressive econometric approach and estimate a network regression estimator that endogenizes peer effects related to knowledge spillovers. The econometric results show that the knowledge spillovers arising from publicly funded R&D networks are positive. We also find that the spillover effects resulting from Research Council programs are much stronger than those of tax incentives, and that the spillover effects are much stronger for collaborations between firms operating in different industries than for within-industry collaborations.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家为研发网络提供公共政策支持。在公共资助的研发联合体中，企业彼此合作并与公共科研机构合作开展联合创新项目。这些政策方案背后的理念是，合作创新使企业能够从研发网络内的知识溢出中获益。然而令人惊讶的是，尚无实证研究表明公共资助的研发联合体中确实存在溢出效应。本文旨在考察研发网络中知识溢出的程度和来源，并将其与协作创新政策项目所产生的其他额外性驱动因素区分开来。我们的实证分析聚焦于挪威，涵盖2002-2022期间受研发政策项目支持的全体企业，包含约15500个合作项目。基于每个项目的信息，我们构建了创新者网络和新的研发溢出池变量。我们使用空间自回归计量经济学方法，并估计了一个将知识溢出相关的同伴效应内生化的网络回归估计量。计量经济学结果表明，来自公共资助研发网络的知识溢出为正。我们还发现，研究理事会项目产生的溢出效应远强于税收激励，并且溢出效应对于在不同行业经营的企业之间的合作远强于行业内合作。

articles.title_en: For the future of our grandchildren: Grandparenthood and climate change concerns
articles.title_cn: 为了我们孙辈的未来：祖父母身份与气候变化担忧
articles.abstract_en: Concerns about offspring’s life quality are often cited as a motivation for caring about climate change. This paper investigates the hypothesized causal effect of grandparenthood on climate change worries, using panel data surveys among British families. Specifically, we study whether becoming a grandparent increases these worries. We employ two different study designs to deal with endogeneity of grandparenthood. Across designs, the assumptions required to identify causal effects differ and are non-nested but give a remarkably congruent result: We find no empirical support for a relationship between grandparental status and concerns about climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 对后代生活质量的担忧常被引为关心气候变化的动机。本文使用英国家庭的面板数据调查，研究祖父母身份对气候变化担忧的假设因果效应。具体而言，我们研究成为祖父母是否会增加这些担忧。我们采用两种不同的研究设计来处理祖父母身份的内生性。在不同设计之间，识别因果效应所需的假设不同且非嵌套，但给出了显著一致的结果：我们没有发现祖父母身份与气候变化担忧之间存在关系的实证支持。

articles.title_en: A new horizon? The effect of a national education reform on student achievement and the academic environment
articles.title_cn: 一个新的视野？全国性教育改革对学生成绩和学术环境的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes the effects of a nationwide school reform in Israel on student achievement and the school learning environment. The New Horizon reform, initiated by the Ministry of Education, was gradually implemented in elementary schools beginning in 2008. It increased the time teachers spend in school, introduced small-group learning, raised teachers’ and principals’ salaries, and established higher requirements and incentives for professional development. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we evaluate the reform’s effects on student achievement and the school learning environment. We find that in the four years following implementation, math and English test scores improved alongside various aspects of the learning environment. We offer suggestive evidence that the math gains are driven by small-group learning targeting lower-achieving students, while English gains are consistent with improved net working conditions for English teachers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了以色列一项全国性学校改革对学生成绩和学校学习环境的影响。由教育部发起的“新视野”改革于2008年开始在小学逐步实施。该改革增加了教师在校时间，引入了小组学习，提高了教师和校长的工资，并建立了更高的专业发展要求和激励措施。我们使用交错双重差分方法评估了改革对学生成绩和学校学习环境的影响。我们发现，在实施后的四年里，数学和英语考试成绩以及学习环境的各个方面都有所改善。我们提供了提示性证据，表明数学成绩的提高是由针对成绩较低学生的小组学习驱动的，而英语成绩的提高与英语教师净工作条件的改善相一致。

articles.title_en: A time-varying approach to assessing fiscal cyclicality: The role of the European fiscal framework
articles.title_cn: 评估财政周期性的时变方法：欧洲财政框架的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper offers new empirical insights into the relationship between the European fiscal framework and the cyclical stance of fiscal policy in EMU countries. By employing a Time-Varying Coefficient (TVC) model, we generate country- and year-specific measures of fiscal cyclicality from 1995 to 2019. We then quantify the evolving intensity of fiscal rules through a country- and year-specific composite index and examine its relationship with fiscal cyclicality via panel regressions with multiple estimators, including a robust IV-GMM specification that addresses endogeneity concerns. This dual-framework strategy enables us to capture the distortion introduced by real-time revisions and identify a significant procyclical bias in peripheral countries, which is largely masked when ex post data are used. In other words, our findings reveal a marked asymmetry: while the estimated relationship between fiscal rules and cyclicality is neutral or mildly countercyclical in core countries, it is significantly procyclical in peripheral ones when real-time data are considered. These results have important implications for the revised European fiscal framework, as the new indicator (i.e., net expenditure) continues to rely on cycle-sensitive variables and may therefore perpetuate the same structural basis. Our analysis calls for a deeper reconsideration of the methodology used to estimate potential output in the EU. By demonstrating how the interaction between fiscal rules and real-time macroeconomic estimates can generate unintended policy outcomes, this study contributes to a more informed debate on the future of fiscal governance in the euro area.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为欧洲财政框架与EMU国家财政政策周期性立场之间的关系提供了新的经验证据。通过采用时变系数（TVC）模型，我们生成了从1995到2019的国别和年度特定的财政周期性度量。随后，我们通过一个国别和年度特定的综合指数来量化财政规则的演变强度，并通过使用多种估计量的面板回归来考察其与财政周期性的关系，其中包括一个解决内生性问题的稳健IV-GMM设定。这种双重框架策略使我们能够捕捉实时修订引入的扭曲，并识别出外围国家显著的顺周期偏差，而这一偏差在使用事后数据时在很大程度上被掩盖。换言之，我们的发现揭示了一种显著的不对称性：当考虑实时数据时，财政规则与周期性之间的估计关系在核心国家为中性或轻度逆周期，而在外围国家则显著为顺周期。这些结果对修订后的欧洲财政框架具有重要含义，因为新指标（即净支出）继续依赖对周期敏感的变量，因此可能延续相同的结构性基础。我们的分析呼吁对欧盟潜在产出估算方法进行更深入的重新考虑。通过展示财政规则与实时宏观经济估算之间的相互作用如何产生意外的政策结果，本研究为关于欧元区财政治理未来的更知情辩论做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Policy interventions to mitigate the long-run costs of Brexit
articles.title_cn: 缓解英国脱欧长期成本的政策干预
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the long-term macroeconomic impacts of Brexit on the UK economy employing a dynamic general equilibrium model that incorporates endogenous firm entry, price markups and market competition. By integrating the trade frictions introduced by Brexit, the model explains how increased trade costs have altered firm behaviour, market structure, and broader economic performance. We assess a range of policy responses, from theoretically optimal but practically difficult tax-subsidy schemes, to more realistic measures aimed at reducing firm entry barriers, encouraging private and public investment, and subsidising labour costs. Our findings underscore the critical role of policies that can most directly influence firm creation, investment, and competition in addressing the structural challenges Brexit has introduced.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文采用一个纳入内生企业进入、价格加成和市场竞争的动态一般均衡模型，考察英国脱欧对英国经济的长期宏观经济影响。通过纳入英国脱欧带来的贸易摩擦，该模型解释了贸易成本上升如何改变企业行为、市场结构以及更广泛的经济表现。我们评估了一系列政策应对措施，从理论上最优但实践中难以实施的税收-补贴方案，到更现实的旨在降低企业进入壁垒、鼓励私人和公共投资以及补贴劳动力成本的措施。我们的发现强调了那些能够最直接影响企业创建、投资和竞争的政策在应对英国脱欧带来的结构性挑战中的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Determinants of gender discrimination by teachers: Evidence from an online experiment
articles.title_cn: 教师性别歧视的决定因素：来自在线实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether teachers’ gender biases stem from discrimination, and focuses on two of its potential drivers: gender preferences and beliefs. In an online experiment, 1840 teachers evaluated fictitious transcripts with randomized gender information. Preferences are measured via dictator games, and beliefs through an Implicit Association Test. While teachers show no gender preferences, they do hold gender beliefs. Analysing 19,000 transcript evaluations, we find no evidence of gender-based discrimination. Our findings suggest that when only exposed to student gender, even teachers with biased beliefs do not discriminate.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察教师的性别偏见是否源于歧视，并聚焦于其两个潜在驱动因素：性别偏好与信念。在一项在线实验中，1840名教师评估了性别信息随机化的虚构成绩单。偏好通过独裁者博弈衡量，信念则通过内隐联想测验衡量。尽管教师未表现出性别偏好，他们确实持有性别信念。分析19,000份成绩单评估后，我们未发现基于性别的歧视证据。我们的发现表明，当仅接触学生性别时，即使持有偏见信念的教师也不会歧视。

articles.title_en: Oil prices and inequality
articles.title_cn: 石油价格与不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a unified framework to understand the effect of oil price changes on the dynamics of consumption, income and wealth inequality. Using data on macroeconomic aggregates, oil prices, and inequality metrics, we first employ a structural vector autoregressive model to show that an increase in oil prices leads to a persistent rise in income and wealth inequality. To understand these dynamics, we then solve an incomplete market model with aggregate oil price shocks, and calibrate the model to the US data. We find that when oil serves as both a consumption good and a production input, positive oil price shocks increase inequality. While the initial rise in inequality is driven by oil-induced stagflation, which forces poorer households to deplete more of their wealth to cover basic consumption, the quicker rebound in interest rates compared to the slower recovery in wages explains why inequality remains persistently elevated.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个统一框架，以理解石油价格变化对消费、收入和财富不平等动态的影响。利用宏观经济总量、石油价格和不平等指标的数据，我们首先采用结构向量自回归模型表明，石油价格上升会导致收入和财富不平等持续上升。为了理解这些动态，我们随后求解了一个包含总体石油价格冲击的不完全市场模型，并根据美国数据对模型进行校准。我们发现，当石油既作为消费品又作为生产投入品时，正向石油价格冲击会加剧不平等。虽然不平等的初始上升由石油引发的滞胀驱动，这迫使较贫困家庭消耗更多财富以支付基本消费，但利率相对于工资的较慢复苏更快反弹，解释了为何不平等持续居高不下。

articles.title_en: The long-term effects of military occupations: Evidence from post-world war II Austria
articles.title_cn: 军事占领的长期影响：来自二战后奥地利的证据
articles.abstract_en: What are the long-run economic consequences of short-lived but intense institutional shocks? We study the post-World War II occupation of Austria, where the country was divided into Soviet and Western Allied zones for ten years before reunification. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design combined with a difference-in-differences approach, we show that areas initially occupied by Soviet forces remain significantly less economically developed today. These regions are less populated, host fewer and lower-paying jobs, and exhibit substantially higher rates of out-commuting than comparable areas in the former Western zones. We show that these persistent differences are driven by a large population flight triggered by the onset of the Soviet occupation, which durably shifted the spatial distribution of economic activity. This initial migration shock altered local agglomeration forces, leading to sustained regional divergence despite the restoration of a unified institutional framework. Our findings highlight how even temporary institutional shocks can have long-lasting economic effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 短暂但强烈的制度冲击会带来怎样的长期经济后果？我们研究二战后对奥地利的占领，当时该国在重新统一前被分为苏联占领区和西方盟国占领区长达十年。我们使用空间断点回归设计并结合双重差分方法，表明最初被苏联军队占领的地区如今经济发展水平仍显著较低。与旧西方占领区的可比地区相比，这些地区人口更少，就业岗位更少且工资更低，通勤外出率也显著更高。我们表明，这些持续差异是由苏联占领开始引发的大规模人口外流所驱动，这一外流持久地改变了经济活动的空间分布。这一初始迁移冲击改变了本地集聚力量，导致尽管统一制度框架得以恢复，区域分化仍持续存在。我们的发现凸显了即使是暂时的制度冲击也能产生持久的经济影响。

articles.title_en: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
articles.title_cn: 偏向常规型的技术变化、就业结构与跨国收入差异
articles.abstract_en: We investigate links between routine-biased technical change, the structure of occupational employment, and cross-country income differences. To implement this, we combine several data sources, including national labour force surveys and the Penn World Tables. In our novel dataset spanning 92 countries, we document a negative relationship between the employment share of routine occupations and GDP per hour worked. We then conduct a development accounting exercise in which we differentiate labour inputs by occupation and allow for occupation-specific technologies. We find a systematic relationship between occupation-specific productivities and development. Labour in routine occupations tends to be much more productive in richer countries, with effective productivity in the top 25 percent being about 14 times higher than in the bottom 25 percent of countries ranked by GDP per hour worked. Cross-country gaps in routine technology alone account for about 17 percent of the 90–10 ratio of GDP per hour worked, whereas differences in abstract labour technology do not contribute to the observed GDP dispersion. Eliminating all occupations’ and capital’s technology differences would compress the GDP distribution by 32 to 40 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究偏向常规型的技术变化、职业就业结构与跨国收入差异之间的联系。为实现这一目标，我们结合了多个数据来源，包括各国劳动力调查和佩恩世界表。在我们涵盖92个国家的新数据集中，我们记录了常规职业就业份额与每小时GDP之间的负向关系。随后，我们进行了一项发展核算练习，其中我们按职业区分劳动投入，并允许职业特定技术存在。我们发现职业特定生产率与发展之间存在系统性关系。常规职业中的劳动在较富裕国家往往生产率高得多，按每小时GDP排名最高的25%个国家中常规职业的有效生产率约比最低的25%个国家高14倍。仅常规技术的跨国差距就解释了每小时GDP的90-10比率中约17%，而抽象劳动技术的差异对观察到的GDP离散度没有贡献。消除所有职业和资本的技术差异将使GDP分布压缩32至40%。

articles.title_en: Local shocks and internal migration: The disparate effects of robots and Chinese imports in the US
articles.title_cn: 局部冲击与国内迁移：美国机器人与中国进口的差异化影响
articles.abstract_en: Migration is a key mechanism through which local labor markets adjust to economic shocks. In this paper, we analyze the migration response of American workers to two of the most important shocks that hit US manufacturing since the 1990s: Chinese import competition and the introduction of industrial robots. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in exposure across US local labor markets over time, we establish a new fact. Even though both shocks drastically reduced employment in the manufacturing sector, only robots led to a sizable decline in population size. We provide evidence that negative employment spillovers outside manufacturing, caused by robots but not by Chinese imports, can explain the different migration responses. We interpret our findings through the lens of a model that highlights two mechanisms: the cost savings that each shock provides and the degree of complementarity between directly and indirectly exposed industries.
articles.abstract_cn: 迁移是本地劳动力市场调整以适应经济冲击的关键机制。在本文中，我们分析了美国工人对自1990以来冲击美国制造业的两个最重要冲击的迁移反应：中国进口竞争和工业机器人的引入。利用美国各地方劳动力市场随时间推移面临的看似外生的暴露程度变化，我们确立了一个新的事实。尽管这两种冲击都大幅减少了制造业部门的就业，但只有机器人导致了人口规模的显著下降。我们提供的证据表明，由机器人而非中国进口引起的制造业之外的负面就业溢出效应，可以解释不同的迁移反应。我们通过一个强调两种机制的模型来解读我们的发现：每种冲击带来的成本节约，以及直接和间接暴露行业之间的互补程度。

articles.title_en: Reference-point effects in bargaining
articles.title_cn: 讨价还价中的参照点效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether an earned endowment can serve as a salient reference point in unstructured bargaining and thereby reshape focal agreements. In a laboratory experiment with 166 participants, subjects earn endowments in a real-effort task, and subsequent bargaining menus are framed as changes relative to these earned endowments, while disagreement yields zero payoffs. The design distinguishes agreements that equalize total earnings (equal splits in final payoffs) from agreements that equalize the incremental surplus relative to the reference point (equal changes). Under symmetric endowments these notions coincide; under asymmetric endowments they diverge, so equalizing total earnings requires an unequal division of the incremental surplus. Results show that equal splits are not universal even under symmetry, and when endowments are asymmetric they lose focality in favor of equal-change and intermediate compromise agreements. The findings are robust across environments in which the reference point is available, dominated by some feasible agreements, or an infeasible claim. The results highlight how the salience and asymmetry of a reference point affects which notion of equality is focal in bargaining.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究挣得的禀赋能否在非结构化讨价还价中充当显著的参照点，从而重塑焦点协议。在一项有166名参与者的实验室实验中，被试在真实努力任务中挣得禀赋，随后的讨价还价菜单被框定为相对于这些挣得禀赋的变化，而未能达成协议则收益为零。该设计区分了使总收益均等化的协议（最终收益的均等分配）与使相对于参照点的增量剩余均等化的协议（均等变化）。在对称禀赋下，这些概念一致；在不对称禀赋下，它们发生分歧，因此使总收益均等化需要对增量剩余进行不均等的分割。结果表明，即使在对称条件下，均等分配也并非普遍存在；而当禀赋不对称时，均等分配失去焦点性，让位于均等变化和中间妥协协议。这些发现在参照点可得、被某些可行协议占优、或作为不可行要求的环境中均稳健。结果凸显了参照点的显著性和不对称性如何影响讨价还价中哪种平等概念成为焦点。

articles.title_en: Goal setting and feedback: the power of joint use
articles.title_cn: 目标设定与反馈：联合使用的力量
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of goal setting and feedback, both in isolation and in combination, and how these effects vary depending on who sets the goal. We study these effects in a non-pecuniary environment common to workplace settings such as the public sector. We compare outcomes across treatments with no goal setting, worker-set goals, and employer-set goals, each implemented with and without employer feedback, and document several key findings. Employers set substantially higher goals than workers, and this gap widens with feedback because employer-set goals increase significantly while worker-set goals remain unchanged. Effort is significantly higher only under the joint use of employer-set goals and feedback; otherwise, effort levels are similar. Specifically, neither feedback nor goal setting has a significant effect on effort when used in isolation. The effect of feedback on effort is positive and statistically significant only when goals are employer-set. Likewise, when feedback is present, only employer-set goals raise effort significantly relative to no goal setting. Finally, employer feedback is sensitive to goal attainment only when goals are set by employers. One possible explanation is that employer-set goals, when paired with feedback, create a sense of social pressure or accountability that leads workers to increase effort.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察目标设定与反馈单独使用及联合使用的效果，以及这些效果如何因目标由谁设定而异。我们在公共部门等职场环境中常见的非金钱环境中研究这些效果。我们比较了无目标设定、工作者设定目标和雇主设定目标三种处理下的结果，每种处理均在有雇主反馈和无雇主反馈的情况下实施，并记录了若干关键发现。雇主设定的目标显著高于工作者，且这一差距在反馈下扩大，因为雇主设定的目标显著提高，而工作者设定的目标保持不变。只有在雇主设定目标与反馈联合使用时，努力才显著更高；否则，努力水平相似。具体而言，反馈或目标设定单独使用时，对努力均无显著影响。只有当目标由雇主设定时，反馈对努力的影响才为正且统计显著。同样，当存在反馈时，只有雇主设定的目标相对于无目标设定显著提高努力。最后，只有当目标由雇主设定时，雇主反馈才对目标达成敏感。一种可能的解释是，雇主设定的目标与反馈搭配时，会产生一种社会压力或问责感，促使工作者增加努力。

articles.title_en: History-dependent monetary policy – less is more
articles.title_cn: 历史依赖型货币政策——少即是多
articles.abstract_en: History-dependent monetary policies (HDMP) can potentially address the challenges that standard monetary policy frameworks face, especially at the ELB. Using controlled laboratory experiments, we identify several vulnerabilities in HDMP. Our analysis of experimental data shows that a weakened expectations channel can undermine HDMP. Experimental participants’ expectations feed off past data; they are not forward-looking and do not internalize the stabilization properties or future make-up strategies of HDMP. Conditional on these expectations, we highlight two risks associated with HDMP: inflation overshoots under average inflation targeting and deflationary spirals under price level targeting and nominal GDP level targeting. However, effective central bank communication through medium-term macroeconomic projections can improve the performance of price level targeting.
articles.abstract_cn: 历史依赖型货币政策（HDMP）可能有助于应对标准货币政策框架所面临的挑战，尤其是在有效下限（ELB）处。通过受控实验室实验，我们识别出HDMP中的若干脆弱性。我们对实验数据的分析表明，减弱的预期渠道可能削弱HDMP。实验参与者的预期依赖于过去的数据；他们并非前瞻性，也不会内化HDMP的稳定属性或未来弥补策略。在这些预期条件下，我们强调与HDMP相关的两个风险：平均通胀目标制下的通胀超调，以及价格水平目标制和名义GDP水平目标制下的通缩螺旋。然而，通过中期宏观经济预测进行有效的央行沟通，可以改善价格水平目标制的表现。

articles.title_en: Original sin redux: A model-based evaluation
articles.title_cn: 原罪重现：基于模型的评估
articles.abstract_en: Using a two-country model, this paper shows that the shift from foreign currency to local currency external borrowing does not eliminate the vulnerability of EMs to foreign financial shocks but instead results in “original sin redux.” A monetary tightening abroad is propagated to EM financial conditions through a tightening of foreign lenders’ financial constraints, driven in part by currency mismatches on their balance sheets. Foreign exchange intervention and capital flow management measures can mitigate global financial spillovers to EMs in the short run and a larger domestic investor base can reduce the vulnerability in the longer run.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文运用两国模型表明，从外币外部借款转向本币外部借款并未消除新兴市场对外国金融冲击的脆弱性，反而导致“原罪重现”。国外的货币紧缩通过收紧外国贷款人的金融约束传导至新兴市场的金融条件，部分原因是其资产负债表上的货币错配。外汇干预和资本流动管理措施可以在短期内缓解全球金融溢出对新兴市场的影响，而更大的国内投资者基础可以在长期内降低脆弱性。

articles.title_en: The structure of discrimination against Turkish migrants in Germany
articles.title_cn: 德国对土耳其移民的歧视结构
articles.abstract_en: We study the structure and heterogeneity of discriminatory behavior using an incentivized choice experiment with a representative sample of over 2000 adults in Germany. Decision-makers allocate a fixed endowment between two receivers whose migration background, education, gender, and age are randomly varied. This design allows us to compare discrimination across attributes within an integrative framework, analyze how these dimensions interact, and classify individuals into behavioral types. We show pronounced discrimination against Turkish migrants in allocation choices, comparable in magnitude to gender-based preferential treatment in favor of women. Discrimination against Turkish migrants varies systematically with other receiver attributes and across decision makers, and is particularly strong among non-migrants and individuals with right-wing political preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一项激励性选择实验，以德国超过2000名成年人的代表性样本为对象，研究歧视行为的结构与异质性。决策者在两个接受者之间分配一笔固定禀赋，接受者的移民背景、教育、性别和年龄被随机变化。这一设计使我们能够在一个整合框架内比较不同属性上的歧视，分析这些维度如何相互作用，并将个体分类为行为类型。我们表明，在分配选择中存在对土耳其移民的显著歧视，其程度与基于性别的、有利于女性的优待相当。对土耳其移民的歧视随其他接受者属性以及决策者不同而系统性变化，并且在非移民和具有右翼政治偏好的个体中尤为强烈。

articles.title_en: The spoils of algorithmic collusion: Profit allocation among asymmetric firms
articles.title_cn: 算法合谋的掠夺物：非对称企业间的利润分配
articles.abstract_en: We study the propensity of independent algorithms to collude in repeated asymmetric Cournot duopolies, specifically the predictive power of various oligopoly and bargaining solutions with respect to the effect of asymmetry among firms. We find that total quantities are below the static Nash level in all specifications, and they increase with asymmetry. Thus, both consumers and firms can benefit from asymmetry. For low (high) levels of asymmetry, the simulated quantities are above (below) the joint profit-maximizing output. While the static Nash equilibrium provides accurate predictions regarding total welfare, bargaining solutions, such as equal relative gains, better capture our finding of convergence to Pareto-efficient outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了独立算法在重复非对称古诺双寡头中合谋的倾向，具体而言是各种寡头与讨价还价解对于企业间非对称性效应的预测能力。我们发现，在所有设定中总产量均低于静态纳什水平，且随非对称性增加而增加。因此，消费者和企业都能从非对称性中受益。对于低（高）水平的非对称性，模拟产量高于（低于）联合利润最大化产出。虽然静态纳什均衡对总福利提供了准确预测，但讨价还价解，如均等相对收益，更好地捕捉了我们发现的向帕累托有效结果的收敛。

articles.title_en: Do women comply more than men? Experimental evidence from a general population sample
articles.title_cn: 女性比男性更顺从吗？来自一般人群样本的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Women are typically perceived as more compliant than men; however, the literature provides inconclusive evidence. Using a novel experimental design comprising two complementary experiments, we test this claim in online samples representative of the German adult population. The first experiment (N = 1600) features a probabilistic social dilemma game (PDG) in which participants can increase their individual payoff at the expense of exposing themselves and their group to probabilistic losses. In two treatment conditions, they receive either a recommendation on socially optimal behavior or the same recommendation plus information on weakly non-compliant peer behavior. We find that the recommendation strongly affects behavior, but more so for women than for men. The welfare improvement is substantial. Information on the non-compliant behavior of others erodes compliance with the recommendation but does not induce significantly different responses in men and women. In the second experiment (N = 522), we elicit empirical and normative expectations about behavior in the PDG with a behavioral recommendation, in order to study the role of norms in adhering to it. While men and women are expected to hold similar normative beliefs, men are expected to follow the recommendation less often, suggesting that compliance is a (strong) female social norm.
articles.abstract_cn: 女性通常被认为比男性更顺从；然而，文献提供的证据尚无定论。我们采用包含两个互补实验的新颖实验设计，在代表德国成年人口的在线样本中检验这一说法。第一个实验（N = 1600）采用概率社会困境博弈（PDG），参与者可以通过让自己和所在群体面临概率性损失为代价来提高个人收益。在两种处理条件下，他们要么收到关于社会最优行为的建议，要么收到同样的建议加上关于弱不顺从同伴行为的信息。我们发现，建议强烈影响行为，但对女性的影响大于男性。福利改善是巨大的。关于他人不顺从行为的信息会削弱对建议的顺从，但并未在男性和女性中引起显著不同的反应。在第二个实验（N = 522）中，我们引出对带有行为建议的PDG中行为的实证和规范预期，以研究规范在遵从建议中的作用。虽然男性和女性被预期持有相似的规范信念，但男性被预期更不经常遵循建议，这表明顺从是一种（强烈的）女性社会规范。

articles.title_en: Ratcheting up Paris
articles.title_cn: 逐步提高巴黎协定的力度
articles.abstract_en: The Paris Agreement is designed to increase climate ambition gradually through a process of ratcheting up. What is the plausible endpoint of this process? To answer this question, we develop a tractable integrated assessment model in which countries interact through a decentralized general equilibrium and negotiate unanimously over a global carbon budget, with all mitigation implemented via a global carbon price. We prove the existence and uniqueness of a unanimous international agreement on global emissions, in which carbon pricing revenues are redistributed across countries in proportion to marginal climate damages. In a quantitative application for 154 countries, the resulting equilibrium limits global mean surface temperature change to 1.51°C, at a carbon price of 320 USD/tCO2. The associated international transfers of carbon pricing revenue are progressive toward lower-income countries and amount to about 0.8% of global GDP annually — an order of magnitude larger than the Paris Agreement’s climate finance target.
articles.abstract_cn: 《巴黎协定》旨在通过逐步提高力度的过程来增加气候雄心。这一过程的合理终点是什么？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一个易于处理的综合评估模型，其中各国通过分散的一般均衡相互作用，并一致谈判全球碳预算，所有减排都通过全球碳价格实施。我们证明了关于全球排放的一致国际协议的存在性和唯一性，其中碳定价收入按边际气候损害的比例在各国之间重新分配。在对154个国家的定量应用中，由此产生的均衡将全球平均地表温度变化限制在1.51°C，碳价格为320 USD/tCO2。相关的碳定价收入国际转移对低收入国家是累进的，每年约为全球GDP的0.8%——比《巴黎协定》的气候融资目标大一个数量级。

articles.title_en: Green jobs require green skills: Why production subsidies are not enough
articles.title_cn: 绿色岗位需要绿色技能：为什么生产补贴还不够
articles.abstract_en: Large structural transitions require both firms and workers to act: firms must create jobs in expanding sectors, and workers must acquire the skills to move into them. The green transition is a leading example, yet most climate policy focuses on the firm side. This paper asks whether production support alone is sufficient for the constrained-efficient allocation, or whether worker-side support is also needed. I develop a two-sector Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides model with sectoral choice and pre-match human-capital investment. Green workers acquire sector-specific skills before matching with firms; because training is sunk at the time of wage bargaining, workers do not internalize the full social return to their investment, even under the Hosios condition. A Pigouvian production subsidy corrects the environmental wedge and aligns vacancy creation for a given level of human capital, but it does not implement the planner’s training choice; so exact decentralization also requires a worker-side training subsidy. In a calibration to the United States, the central quantitative comparison holds fixed the green-employment target: a production-only policy is chosen to reach the same 14% benchmark as the coordinated policy, but it does so with lower green human capital and lower output. The break-even environmental value of green output for the coordinated policy is 1.13% of the numeraire output unit. It thus shows that, even conditional on the same green employment expansion, policy design determines the skill intensity and productivity of the green expansion.
articles.abstract_cn: 大规模结构性转型需要企业和工人共同行动：企业必须在扩张部门创造岗位，工人必须获得技能以进入这些岗位。绿色转型是一个典型例子，但大多数气候政策聚焦于企业一侧。本文追问：仅靠生产支持是否足以实现约束有效配置，还是也需要工人一侧的支持。我构建了一个包含部门选择与匹配前人力资本投资的两部门Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides模型。绿色工人在与企业匹配之前获得部门特定技能；由于培训在工资谈判时已成沉没成本，工人不会将其投资的全部社会回报内部化，即使在Hosios条件下也是如此。庇古生产补贴纠正了环境楔子，并在给定人力资本水平下使空缺创造对齐，但它并不实施规划者的培训选择；因此，精确分权还需要工人一侧的培训补贴。在对美国的校准中，核心定量比较固定绿色就业目标：选择仅生产政策以达到与协调政策相同的14%基准，但它以更低的绿色人力资本和更低的产出实现这一目标。协调政策的绿色产出盈亏平衡环境价值为计价产出单位的1.13%。因此这表明，即使以相同的绿色就业扩张为条件，政策设计也决定了绿色扩张的技能强度与生产率。
